name: RavenForge
creator: Walker Pollitt
ownership: RavenForge is proprietary software created and owned by Walker Pollitt. Patent application pending.
summary: A governed context and workflow platform for AI-assisted engineering. RavenForge connects task execution, evidence, persistent actor continuity, and reviewable decisions across tools and model providers.

features.name: Governed task exchange
features.description: ROOKERY coordinates task admission, exclusive checkout, output validation, and accepted check-in with recorded provenance.

features.name: Task and compute visibility
features.description: WAYFINDER provides weighted task selection and visibility into available compute and runtime readiness.

features.name: Health and freshness monitoring
features.description: HEIMDALL observes component health, evidence freshness, and recorded boundary findings.

features.name: Separate continuity stores
features.description: Personal context, project records, and individual Actor Wells remain separate. Actor and project workflows retain traceable continuity and decision records.

features.name: Context recovery across sessions
features.description: Actor workflows have recovered prior reports and corrections in fresh sessions, preserving the source and provenance of supplied context.

features.name: Asterion coding workflow
features.description: A real provider-backed coding task produced a Python source change, passed eight independent checks, completed governed check-in, and recorded the actor's own continuity.

development_note: RavenForge is under active development. Additional provider integrations, local model execution, and broader autonomous workflows are being tested. Public demonstrations illustrate concepts and are separate from private operations.
